response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong software engineering skills, distributed systems experience, and some exposure to AI-agent infrastructure through his recent work at re:cinq. However, his background lacks direct experience in fintech infrastructure, regulated environments, or scaling multi-agent AI systems for high-stakes commercial applications. His leadership experience is also not clearly aligned with venture-backed scale-ups or executive roles.
strengths: Extensive backend and distributed-systems expertise (event-driven systems, microservices, real-time processing)
Hands-on experience with AI-agent frameworks and developer tooling (MCP, agentic workflows)
Strong open-source contributions and technical leadership in community-driven projects
concerns: Limited fintech infrastructure experience (credit systems, payment flows, embedded finance)
No clear track record in regulated or high-stakes commercial AI systems
Lacks executive-level leadership experience in venture-backed scale-ups (current role is Staff, not CTO)
